title: Wonderful cooking class & great people!
text: Alfonso and Txema welcomed us into their home for a lovely, individualized experience making a Spanish omelet, gazpacho, Russian salad, and much more. They made us feel at home in their stunning apartment, and we enjoyed meeting their pets. We prepared the dishes in their kitchen and dining room, then had a wonderful lunch on their beautiful rooftop terrace. It was a lovely experience and we enjoyed every minute!
author: Lisa_M

title: Amazing, personal, in-home cooking lessons!
text: What an amazing, personalized experience. We enjoyed every minute of this dining and cooking experience. The hosts were fantastic, the food was delicious, 10/10 recommend! Thank you Alfonso and Txema, and also Grey the king/queen of the neighborhood.
author: 113nicolej

title: Loved our tapas & sangria making class!
text: Our tapas & sangria making class was a great experience. Alfonso was a wonderful host. We had a lot of fun helping to prep our tapas & sangria. Highly recommend this experience.
author: cheryld148

title: Wonderful BCN cooking class with Alfonso and Chema
text: Really fun. Great food and lots of it. In a scenic neighborhood of BCN and wonderful, atmospheric apartment. Alphonso is a wonderful teacher and host.
author: Meg_S

title: Wonderful class with beautiful view!
text: Very hands on class, we learned so much! One thing we feel that is not adequately advertised is the view, it is incredible!! We were not able to eat on the rooftop due to weather but even the view from the apartment is beautiful! We'd love to do another class with them!
author: O5357XAnancyh

author: Jane_M

title: Thank you so much for...
text: Thank you so much for having us for your tapas and sangaria experience.. we thoroughly enjoyed our time and the food was delicious.  Highly recommend Alfonso & Txema… very warm and welcoming.. 😊 Ryan & Tracy, Australia
author: Ryan_B

title: Excellent! So fun and tasty
text:
Amazing experience. Great couple. Tasty food. Beautiful home.

My wife and i took the tour. We had so much fun cooking, laughing, and eating.

We made the Spanish omelet when we returned home and it was so good we ate it all. Also when watching the world cup, we prepared some sangria. It was excellent and made me wish I had doubled the recipe.

Please respect the chef, this is a cooking and eating class, not just for pictures on Instagram and TikTok.
author: Mark_C

title: A perfect afternoon in Barcelona!
text: Your hosts are super and have a fantastic rooftop deck. The food was great, the champagne a surprise, and we learned a lot.
author: Marty_D

title: Authentic Tapas & Sangria class
text:
This cooking class is a fantastic way to spend a few hours  enjoying the hospitality of hosts Alfonso and Txema, who welcomed us into their home. 

Over the next few hours we were assisted in making Spanish omelette; Russian salad; gazpacho; mushrooms with shrimp; chicken croquettes; tomato and garlic toast; and sangria to accompany the meal. 

Afterwards we got to enjoy this fabulous food on their rooftop terrace! Thank you for sharing your home and passion of food with us!
author: Kate_W
